description: Defines enums, classes, and methods related to E2SM KPM metrics, labels, and measurement provider interface within the ocudu namespace.

classes.name: e2sm_kpm_meas_provider
classes.description: Abstract interface class for providing measurement data and support checks for E2SM KPM metrics.

methods.name: get_supported_metric_names
methods.description: Returns a list of supported metric names for a given level.

methods.name: is_cell_supported
methods.description: Checks if a cell with the specified global ID is supported.

methods.name: is_ue_supported
methods.description: Checks if a UE with the specified ID is supported.

methods.name: is_test_cond_supported
methods.description: Checks if a specific test condition type is supported.

methods.name: is_metric_supported
methods.description: Checks if a metric with given labels, level, and cell scope is supported.

methods.name: get_ues_matching_test_conditions
methods.description: Retrieves UE IDs matching specified test conditions.

methods.name: get_ues_matching_test_conditions
methods.description: Retrieves UE IDs matching specified UE test conditions.

methods.name: get_meas_data
methods.description: Collects measurement data for a specified metric, labels, UEs, and cell scope.
